question: What is my company car lease budget?

answer.headline: Don't act yet — sources disagree
answer.detail: €750 per month (C) vs €800 per month (F) for Belgium — all clients.

sources.title: Company car policy 2025 — Belgium
sources.statement: The company car lease budget in Belgium is €750 per month.
sources.quote: the monthly lease budget for car-eligible functions is €750
sources.body: Company car policy (2025). From 1 January 2025 the monthly lease budget for car-eligible functions is €750, including fuel card, insurance and maintenance. Questions go to Fleet & Mobility BE (Sofie Verhaegen).

applicability.text: Applies to all clients in Belgium

reasons.text: Corroborated by 1 independent source(s): New joiner FAQ — company car (Belgium)

sources.statement: The company car lease budget in Belgium is €650 per month.
sources.body: Company car policy (2023). Employees in a car-eligible function get a monthly lease budget of €650, including fuel card and insurance. A bigger car is possible with a personal contribution.

sources.statement: The company car lease budget in the Netherlands is €700 per month.
sources.body: Leaseautoregeling (2025). Medewerkers in een functie met leaseauto hebben een maandelijks leasebudget van €700, inclusief brandstof en verzekering.

sources.title: Town hall Q3 2026 — Belgium
sources.statement: The company car lease budget will rise to €800 per month from 1 January 2027.

sources.body: Leadership: on mobility, the car lease budget will rise to €800 per month from 1 January 2027. Until then the 2025 car policy stays as it is; Fleet will update the policy before year end.
